name: 隋
feature: 重归一统，开创科举与大运河。
featureEn: Reunified the realm; founded the exam system and the Grand Canal.
summary: 制度创制(科举、运河)深远，短祚而承前启后。
summaryEn: Its institutions (exams, canal) had lasting impact; short-lived but bridging.

emperors.noteEn: The Kaihuang era of good rule; ended the division
Dug the canal, campaigned against Goguryeo; fell

其他.note: 赵州桥，现存最古石拱桥
其他.noteEn: Zhaozhou Bridge, the oldest surviving stone arch bridge

policiesEn: The Three Departments and Six Ministries

政治: 结束南北分裂，重建大一统
创立三省六部制，开科举取士之先
经济: 开凿大运河，贯通南北漕运
推行均田制与租庸调制，营建粮仓东都
文化: 雕版印刷术初现（印刷术之始）

政治: Ended the north–south split; rebuilt unification
Created the Three Departments and Six Ministries; pioneered exam-based recruitment
经济: Dug the Grand Canal, linking north–south transport
Pursued the equal-field and zuyongdiao; built granaries and the Eastern Capital
文化: Northern and southern literary styles blended
Woodblock printing first appeared (the start of printing)
